dispersion.assumptions: Nominal room-temperature glass; air index approximated as one.

proof.text: dn/dlambda<0 across all samples. With i1 fixed, r1 decreases as n increases; r2=60deg-r1 increases, so e2=asin(n*sin(r2)) increases. D=i1+e2-60deg is therefore larger for violet. The explicit vector trace independently verifies this.

limitations: Geometric optics, not a Maxwell wave simulation: no diffraction, polarization or Fresnel secondary reflections.
301 equal-wavelength samples approximate a continuous white-light spectrum; RGB display colors are illustrative, not calibrated spectral radiometry.
Apparatus dimensions are schematic metre-scale geometry; the laboratory arrangement can be uniformly scaled without changing angles or normalized image geometry.
Volumetric visibility and vertical slit footprint are presentation approximations; every centerline and spectral boundary is calculated.
